reasoning_content:
Ports 18005, 18007, 18008 returned 000 — either not listening, or the readiness path is different. Let me check which services those are and what their readiness probes are. Also 18014 returned 404 on /healthz (different readiness path — `/docs`?).

Let me map ports to service names and check the specific readiness paths.

action.command:
cd /workspace
# map port -> service name
for port in 18005 18007 18008 18014; do
  svc=$(awk -v p="$port" '$0 ~ "--port "p" " {name=$0} /command:/{c=$0} END{}' /dev/null; grep -B40 "\-\-port $port " process-compose.yaml | grep -oE 'name: [a-z0-9-]+' | tail -1)
  echo "port $port -> $svc"
done
